title: Printer Rate Became Per Printer Per Minute
text: id: COMP-005 domain: math title: Printer Rate Became Per Printer Per Minute tags: rates, printers, unit-rate memory: A printer problem became clear only when I found the per-printer-per-minute rate. Four printers and six minutes made a combined work window, not a single machine. I divided pages by printers and minutes, then rebuilt the new combined rate for the smaller printer group. The final time carried minutes, not pages.
